description: Add a second sidebar mode for tmux sessions, entered with `Alt-B`, using the same sidebar style and navigation feel as the current window mode. Session mode should list sessions first, let the user move with Vim-like keys, and attach/select the highlighted session. Keep the mode separate from the current window sidebar so the user can switch between workspace-level and window-level navigation deliberately. Acceptance: `Alt-B` opens a session sidebar, the user can move through sessions, and selecting one attaches or focuses that session.
title: Add tmux sidebar session mode
